_comment: WP-G3B served config of f_bwd_gb300 (PREREGISTRATION_BWD.md 0 / 3.1-3.5 / B0.2 / B1): CP1 form F5b-1+jmax at f0_bwd 1800 MHz x the two-term clock input (s_bwd 0.664) + the S4-bwd ring layer read from the timed variants (S4-bwd served (PB B5 (iii)-(iv) + B5.1 + B6): W0 per class (timed comm_only, as read); glue class-direct on the comm traces (prep + B4.1 helpers on the ACTIVE tokens + accumulate per dKV MiB + memset + copy; helpers follow the clock, the rest clock-independent); X = x0 + kappa sum W0 from the exposed exchange on the comm traces (H1 False); pre served; kernel entries under the structural law (lambda 0.5757) at the CP group's median attention-phase clock; kernel scale 0.8734138708146022); kernel entry per the served model's u_treatment (none: none = PB B7, tile + k0 + b_S q_phys + tau rho n_chain + static(n), no U subtraction; subtracted_in_fit = run 7; inside_k0 = F5b(step) - O_graph_bwd(P_q)); ring prep mode class_direct (PB B7 (ii) decided on the 108 walls); every 3.5 alternative is a named setting scored alongside, never selected on sealed rows

clock_input.amendment: PREREGISTRATION_BWD.md 3.3 / B0.2 (two-term law served from the first freeze; alpha 1 and 0.76 frozen alternatives) / CD A25
clock_input.f_crit_rule: min over the CP group's ranks of the heater-phase SM clock telemetry mean (clock card f_crit; A19.1 (i))
clock_input.rule: served = O_graph_bwd + (F5b_f0 - O_graph_bwd) x [s f0 / f + 1 - s] at cp = 1; at cp > 1 every step's kernel entry x [s f0 / f_crit + 1 - s]; glue / exchange / pre unscaled
clock_input.two_term_s_source: hardware profile backward.two_term_s_bwd (PRIOR-served (BG2.2) alongside the structural law: the GB200 B1.1 value 0.664 (the served law is structural - two_term is the frozen alternative); the GB300 reads RECORDED, not served: card-clock s 0.688 +- 0.008 (384 nocomm bprop pairs, cells (i) + (iv)), implied-clock s 0.908 +- 0.016 (BG2.2: alpha ~ 1 by construction); the (a, e) pairs (BG2.1) sit at the same clock as arm (a) - no lever)

helper_terms.rule: PB B4.1: wall = H_q + H_kv + form with H per HEAD-TOKEN per (hardware, head_dim); the form was fitted on wall_norm - H; CP1BwdModel.kernel() adds H back; the helper classes follow the two-term clock law

helper_variants.rule: PB B4.1: served H variant decided by the per-unit table (cp1_bwd_selection.json helper_variant_decision); the other variant and the no-helper fit are frozen alternatives

port_note: HARDWARE gb300 (PREREGISTRATION_BWD_GB300.md section 3): the GB200 round-1 structure (B7.1) re-read on the gb300 lanes at f0_bwd 1800 MHz; the clock law of the ring block = the profile's backward.clock_law (PRIOR-served (BG2.2)); the structural constants from /data/tailaim/work_data/dcp_benchmark/experiments/attention-coverage-20260925/campaigns/wp-g5-gb300-structural/phase2/served/fits/structural_constants_bwd_gb300.json; the sealed items f_bwd_gb300, h_bwd_gb300; the scorer applies the law from each sealed row's own card (crit_s4bwd; served_f0 alongside)

kernel_law.formula: k(f) = tile f0/f + (1 - lambda) C f0/f + lambda C; tile = tau x chain tiles (+ tau_jmax J_max), C = k0 + b_S S + tau rho n_chain + static(n) (U excluded)
kernel_law.lambda_source: analyst file clock_law_lambda_bwd.json (sha 6373bcc19f20): PRIOR-served (BG2.2): GB200 B6.1 lambda 0.5757 +- 0.031 (analyst file clock_law_lambda_bwd.json under BD pending_bwd, sha 04bb764385f0); the GB300 reads (card-clock 0.356 / implied-clock 0.012) are recorded alternatives in clock_law_lambda_bwd_gb300.json; re-read and replaced by amendment if a later GB300 lane gives two MEASURED clocks with a lever >= 10 %

clock.note: PB B6: the ring block's law pre-splits every kernel entry (structural: tile + (1 - lambda) C scaled under alpha 1, lambda C unscaled); the split's clock_law_override carries it; this block applies to blocks without a law

s4bwd.text: S4-bwd served (PB B5 (iii)-(iv) + B5.1 + B6): W0 per class (timed comm_only, as read); glue class-direct on the comm traces (prep + B4.1 helpers on the ACTIVE tokens + accumulate per dKV MiB + memset + copy; helpers follow the clock, the rest clock-independent); X = x0 + kappa sum W0 from the exposed exchange on the comm traces (H1 False); pre served; kernel entries under the structural law (lambda 0.5757) at the CP group's median attention-phase clock; kernel scale 0.8734138708146022

ring.H1: H1 FAILS in some CP class (the failing cells are listed); PB B5 (iii): the served X stays x0 + kappa sum W0 from the exposed exchange on the comm traces (remainder.served false); the per-cell landing records are frozen
ring.H2: H2 FAILS: traced glue vs timed G outside 10 % on the short or the long packs (class median)

selection.mode: PINNED F5b-1+jmax (PREREGISTRATION_BWD_GB300.md decision (1) / BG3.1); the rule's choice F5b-1 recorded

u_treatment.rule: PB B7 (i): the CP1 form fitted on wall_norm - H, static only, NO U / O_graph subtraction (k0 positive; the CP1 non-helper glue lives in k0 + b_S S); the run-7 U-subtracted structure is the frozen alternative cp1_u_subtracted

variants.text: the critical-rank accounting: wall = pre + max_rank sum_i (k'_i + g_i) + X (PB section 0)
